ex.en: Our plane landed just before the rain began.
ex.zh: 我们的飞机刚降落，雨就下起来了。

ex.en: Travelling by plane saves time, but its environmental impact should be considered when planning transport policy.
ex.zh: 乘飞机出行节省时间，但制定交通政策时应考虑其环境影响。

tip: by plane不加冠词；on a plane需加冠词。

ex.en: We took a taxi home with our heavy bags.
ex.zh: 我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。

ex.en: Improving public transport could reduce dependence on taxis and private cars in crowded city centres.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以减少人们在拥挤的市中心对出租车和私家车的依赖。

col: hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车
tip: 乘出租车可说take a taxi或by taxi。

senses.en: a place on the side of a road where buses stop for passengers

ex.en: We wait quietly at the bus stop near our school gate.
ex.zh: 我们在学校大门附近的公交站安静地等车。

ex.en: Every rainy morning, many students hold colorful umbrellas while waiting at the neighborhood bus stop.
ex.zh: 每个下雨的早晨，许多学生都会打着彩色雨伞在社区公交站等车。

col: at the bus stop｜在公交站
walk to the bus stop｜走到公交站
tip: 表示“在公交站”常搭配介词at使用，构成短语at the bus stop。

ex.en: We hurried to the station with our heavy suitcases.
ex.zh: 我们提着沉重的行李箱匆忙赶往车站。

ex.en: Local authorities should station trained staff at busy transport hubs to assist passengers with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 地方政府应在繁忙的交通枢纽安排受过培训的工作人员，帮助行动不便的乘客。

tip: 作动词常用被动式be stationed at，表示被派驻。

ex.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
ex.zh: 过马路前要向两边看。

ex.en: Investment in road maintenance can improve public safety and reduce transport costs for local businesses.
ex.zh: 投资道路养护能提高公共安全水平，并降低当地企业的运输成本。

col: the road to recovery｜康复之路
tip: on the road常指在旅途中；road to可比喻通往某结果的途径。

ex.en: Please open the window and let some fresh air in.
ex.zh: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

ex.en: Installing larger windows can reduce the need for artificial lighting in homes during daylight hours.
ex.zh: 安装更大的窗户可以减少住宅在白天对人工照明的需求。

col: a window of opportunity｜机会之窗
tip: 电脑窗口也叫window；机会之窗强调时机有限。

ex.en: Please leave your wet boots beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿靴子放在门旁边。

ex.en: Creating walking paths beside urban rivers can encourage physical activity and improve residents' access to nature.
ex.zh: 在城市河流旁修建步道可以鼓励身体活动，并让居民更容易亲近自然。

col: sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边
tip: beside表示“在旁边”；besides表示“此外；除……之外”。

ex.en: The children played outside while their parents prepared lunch.
ex.zh: 父母准备午饭时，孩子们在外面玩耍。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to learn outside the classroom through practical activities and community projects.
ex.zh: 学校应通过实践活动和社区项目，为学生提供课堂之外的学习机会。

tip: 后接地点用介词 outside；单独使用可作副词。

senses.en: the short sound made by a car or toy horn

ex.en: Boop! Boop! The toy car makes a funny sound in the room.
ex.zh: 嘀！嘀！玩具小汽车在房间里发出了有趣的喇叭声。

ex.en: Boop, boop! The yellow school bus honks gently to tell students to climb aboard quickly.
ex.zh: 嘀，嘀！黄色校车轻轻鸣笛，提醒学生们快点上车。

tip: 拟声词，模仿汽车或玩具发出的短促喇叭声，字母oo发长音/uː/。

senses.en: the sound of a steam train whistle or engine moving along tracks

ex.en: Choo, choo! Look at that long green train on the bridge.
ex.zh: 呜，呜！快看桥上那列长长的绿色火车。

ex.en: Choo, choo! The steam train blows white smoke into the sky as it leaves the station.
ex.zh: 呜，呜！蒸汽火车驶离车站时向天空喷出白色的烟雾。

col: a choo-choo train｜嘟嘟响的小火车
tip: 拟声词，常连续说Choo, choo!来模仿火车开动时的汽笛声。

senses.en: a short, high sound made by a car horn

ex.en: Beep, beep! A white taxi is coming down the narrow road.
ex.zh: 滴滴！一辆白色出租车正沿着窄路开过来。

ex.en: Beep, beep! The driver presses the horn gently to warn people walking near the busy corner.
ex.zh: 滴滴！司机轻轻按响喇叭，提醒在繁忙拐角处行走的人们。

col: a loud beep｜一声响亮的喇叭声
tip: 拟声词，模仿汽车按喇叭的“滴滴”声，中间两个ee发长音/iː/。

senses.en: to stay in one place until someone arrives or something happens

ex.en: I always wait for my best friend at the school gate.
ex.zh: 我总是在学校大门口等我最好的朋友。

ex.en: On snowy winter days, children wait for the warm sunshine to melt ice in the yard.
ex.zh: 在飘雪的冬日，孩子们等待温暖的阳光融化院子里的冰。

col: wait for the bus｜等公交车
tip: wait表示“等待”，如果后面要接等待的人或事物，必须加上介词for。

ex.en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
ex.zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？

ex.en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。

col: the right thing to do｜正确的做法
first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事
one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

senses.en: to ride and move smoothly on a skateboard

ex.en: My brother can skate fast on his red skateboard in the park.
ex.zh: 我哥哥能在公园里踩着他的红色滑板滑得很快。

ex.en: Every Saturday morning, older kids wear helmets and knee pads when they skate on smooth paths.
ex.zh: 每周六早上，大一点的孩子们在平坦小路上滑滑板时都会戴头盔和护膝。

col: skate in the park｜在公园滑滑板
tip: 本课中主要指“滑滑板”，注意sk在词首时k要浊化读成接近/ɡ/的音。

ex.en: The little bird hopped across the wet garden path.
ex.zh: 那只小鸟蹦跳着穿过湿漉漉的花园小径。

ex.en: Activities that encourage children to hop and balance can support physical development in early education.
ex.zh: 在早期教育中，鼓励儿童单脚跳和平衡身体的活动有助于身体发育。

col: hop on a bus｜迅速上公交车
tip: 过去式hopped，进行式hopping，需双写p。

ex.en: We watched the ducks swimming across the quiet pond.
ex.zh: 我们看着鸭子游过平静的池塘。

ex.en: Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.
ex.zh: 观看教育节目的学生可能获得实用知识，但积极讨论有助于加深理解。

tip: watch 强调持续观看；see 强调看见这一结果。

ex.en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
ex.zh: 每次去海边，我都会收集光滑的石头。

ex.en: Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.
ex.zh: 研究人员收集当地家庭的数据，以评估交通政策如何影响日常出行习惯。

tip: 英式英语collect someone可指去接某人。

ex.en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
ex.zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。

ex.en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。

tip: together通常作副词：一起做某事用动词加together。

senses.en: to look at a movie at a cinema or on a screen

ex.en: We plan to watch a film together at the cinema tonight.
ex.zh: 我们计划今晚一起去电影院看一场电影。

ex.en: On rainy Sundays, our whole family likes to stay inside and watch a film about nature.
ex.zh: 在下雨的周日，我们全家人喜欢待在家里看一部关于大自然的电影。

col: watch a film together｜一起看电影
watch a funny film｜看搞笑电影
go to watch a film｜去看电影
tip: film指“电影”，表示观看动态画面（如电影、电视）通常用动词watch。

senses.en: to look at shows or news on a television screen

ex.en: I never watch TV before I finish all my evening homework.
ex.zh: 我在做完所有晚上的作业之前从不看电视。

ex.en: After dinner, my grandparents sit on the sofa and watch TV to learn about daily weather.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我的祖父母坐在沙发上看电视，了解每天的天气情况。

col: watch TV at home｜在家看电视
like to watch TV｜喜欢看电视
tip: TV是television的缩写，两个字母都要大写，且前面不加the。

senses.en: to gather seashells from the beach and keep them

ex.en: Little Amy likes to collect shells along the sandy beach.
ex.zh: 小艾米喜欢沿着沙滩收集贝壳。

ex.en: During our summer trip to Shenzhen Bay, we walk on the sand and collect shells happily.
ex.zh: 夏天去深圳湾游玩时，我们在沙滩上散步，开心地收集贝壳。

col: collect shells on the beach｜在海滩收集贝壳
like to collect shells｜喜欢收集贝壳
collect pretty shells｜收集漂亮的贝壳
tip: collect表示“收集、搜集”，贝壳通常不止一个，所以shell要加s。

senses.en: to gather postage stamps from letters as a fun hobby

ex.en: My grandfather loves to collect stamps and keep them in albums.
ex.zh: 我爷爷喜欢收集邮票，并把它们放进集邮册里。

ex.en: In our hobby sharing lesson, Tom shows everyone colorful animal pictures because he likes to collect stamps.
ex.zh: 在兴趣分享课上，汤姆向大家展示彩色的动物图案，因为他喜欢收集邮票。

col: collect stamps as a hobby｜把集邮当作爱好
love to collect stamps｜喜欢集邮
tip: stamp意为“邮票”，集邮一般收集多张，因此要用复数stamps。

ex.en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
ex.zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。

ex.en: Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂供应新鲜沙拉，有助于鼓励儿童摄入更多种类的蔬菜。

tip: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。

senses.en: the meat of a fish used as food

ex.en: I like eating steamed fish with rice for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今天晚饭我喜欢吃清蒸鱼肉配米饭。

ex.en: Our school dining hall cooks fresh fish every Tuesday because it helps growing children stay healthy.
ex.zh: 我们学校食堂每周二都会做新鲜的鱼肉，因为这有助于成长中的孩子保持健康。

tip: 表示食物“鱼肉”时，fish是不可数名词，后面不能加s或es。

senses.en: Meat from a chicken that is cooked and eaten as food.

ex.en: Mom cooked some delicious chicken and rice for our dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 妈妈今晚为我们做了美味的鸡肉和米饭当晚餐。

ex.en: Our school dining hall serves warm chicken soup with fresh vegetables every Wednesday.
ex.zh: 我们学校食堂每周三都会供应搭配新鲜蔬菜的热鸡肉汤。

tip: 作“鸡肉”讲时是不可数名词，不能加s，也不能直接用a修饰。

ex.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
ex.zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一块巧克力
a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。

ex.en: I topped my warm porridge with sliced banana.
ex.zh: 我在热燕麦粥上放了些香蕉片。

ex.en: Schools can offer porridge at breakfast to provide pupils with an affordable and nutritious meal.
ex.zh: 学校可以在早餐时提供燕麦粥，让学生吃上价格实惠、营养丰富的一餐。

col: a bowl of porridge｜一碗燕麦粥
tip: 通常为不可数名词；一碗用a bowl of。

senses.en: a round sweet Chinese cake eaten during the Mid-Autumn Festival

ex.en: We share a sweet mooncake under the bright round moon.
ex.zh: 我们在明亮的圆月下分享一块甜甜的月饼。

ex.en: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, every Chinese family eats a round mooncake to celebrate being together.
ex.zh: 中秋节期间，每个中国家庭都会吃圆圆的月饼，庆祝团圆。

tip: 由moon（月亮）和cake（蛋糕）合成，“月饼”在词典中常合写为一词。

senses.en: used politely to say you want or wish to do something

ex.en: I would like to drink a glass of warm milk now.
ex.zh: 我现在愿意喝一杯温牛奶。

ex.en: Every student in our class would like to help clean the school garden this Friday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们班的每位同学这周五下午都愿意帮忙打扫学校花园。

col: would like to help｜愿意帮忙
would like some water｜想要些水
tip: would like比want更礼貌，后接动词时用to加动词原形。

senses.en: yes, certainly; used to agree happily to a request

ex.en: Sure! You can borrow my colored pencils for art class.
ex.zh: 当然可以！你可以借我的彩色铅笔上美术课。

ex.en: When Lily asked if she could join our science team, we smiled and said sure.
ex.zh: 当莉莉问她能不能加入我们的科学小组时，我们笑着说“当然可以”。

col: Sure, here you are.｜当然，给你。
Sure, let's go!｜当然，我们走吧！
tip: 用于愉快地答应请求，相当于Of course，注意词首字母s发/ʃ/。

senses.en: used with I, you, we, they, or plural nouns to make a negative sentence

ex.en: I don't like sour lemons, but I love sweet apples.
ex.zh: 我不喜欢酸柠檬，但我喜欢甜苹果。

ex.en: Most owls sleep peacefully during the sunny day and don't look for food until night.
ex.zh: 大多数猫头鹰在晴朗的白天安稳睡觉，直到晚上才去寻找食物。

tip: 用于构成一般现在时的否定句，放在实义动词前面，后接动词原形。

ex.en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
ex.zh: 我在回家的路上买了些新鲜面包。

ex.en: Some residents support the proposed cycle lanes, while others worry about losing parking spaces.
ex.zh: 一些居民支持拟建的自行车道，另一些人则担心停车位会减少。

tip: 可修饰复数名词或不可数名词；弱读常为/səm/。

ex.en: Thanks for helping me carry these heavy bags upstairs.
ex.zh: 谢谢你帮我把这些沉重的袋子搬上楼。

ex.en: Public expressions of thanks can help volunteers feel valued and encourage continued participation in community projects.
ex.zh: 公开表达感谢能让志愿者感到受重视，并鼓励他们持续参与社区项目。

col: thanks for your help｜谢谢你的帮助
tip: thanks for后接名词或动名词；thanks to表示多亏。

ex.en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边找到了一家安静的餐馆。

ex.en: Local restaurants can attract tourists by serving traditional dishes made with ingredients from nearby farms.
ex.zh: 当地餐馆可以用附近农场的食材制作传统菜肴，以此吸引游客。

col: book a table at a restaurant｜预订餐馆座位
tip: restaurant指用餐场所；hotel主要指住宿的酒店。

ex.en: My sister loves watching animals at the local farm.
ex.zh: 我妹妹喜欢在当地农场看动物。

ex.en: Protecting animal habitats is essential because biodiversity supports stable ecosystems and benefits human wellbeing.
ex.zh: 保护动物栖息地至关重要，因为生物多样性有助于维持生态系统稳定，并造福人类。

tip: animal 不仅指哺乳动物；鸟、鱼和昆虫也属于动物。

ex.en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the highest leaves.
ex.zh: 那只长颈鹿伸长脖子去够最高处的叶子。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining healthy giraffe populations and preserving biodiversity in African grasslands.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持健康的长颈鹿种群和保护非洲草原的生物多样性至关重要。

col: a herd of giraffes｜一群长颈鹿
tip: 重音在第二音节，复数通常加-s。

ex.en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
ex.zh: 一条小蛇悄悄滑过干草丛。

ex.en: Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.
ex.zh: 虽然蛇常令人恐惧，但它们通过控制啮齿动物及其他动物的数量，帮助维持生态平衡。

tip: 作动词表示蜿蜒，常搭配through或along。

ex.en: The elephant sprayed water over its back with its trunk.
ex.zh: 大象用鼻子把水喷到自己的背上。

ex.en: Protecting elephant habitats requires cooperation between conservation organisations, local communities, and governments across national borders.
ex.zh: 保护大象栖息地需要保护组织、当地社区和各国政府开展跨国合作。

col: a herd of elephants｜一群大象
tip: 复数为elephants；象鼻用trunk，不用nose。

ex.en: A zebra stood quietly beside the watering hole.
ex.zh: 一匹斑马静静地站在水塘旁。

ex.en: Protecting grasslands helps zebra populations survive while preserving habitats for many other wild animals.
ex.zh: 保护草原有助于斑马种群生存，同时也为许多其他野生动物保留栖息地。

col: a herd of zebras｜一群斑马
tip: zebra crossing 是英式英语中的斑马线。

senses.en: a cute, friendly word for a little dog

ex.en: The cute brown doggy wags its short tail at me.
ex.zh: 那只可爱的棕色小狗正冲我摇着短尾巴。

ex.en: Every afternoon after school, the little doggy runs happily to the door to greet its owner.
ex.zh: 每天下午放学后，这只小狗都会开心地跑到门口迎接它的主人。

col: a cute doggy｜一只可爱的小狗
tip: 由dog双写g再加y构成，带有亲切可爱的语气，复数把y变i加es。

senses.en: a very young duck

ex.en: A soft yellow duckling swims behind its mother in the pond.
ex.zh: 一只毛茸茸的黄色小鸭在池塘里跟着妈妈游泳。

ex.en: In the famous fairy tale, an ugly duckling grows up into a beautiful white swan.
ex.zh: 在著名的童话故事里，一只丑小鸭长大成了一只美丽的白天鹅。

col: a baby duckling｜一只小鸭宝宝
tip: duck是“鸭”，加上后缀-ling表示幼小动物，合起来就是“小鸭”。

ex.en: A deer stood quietly beside the forest path.
ex.zh: 一只鹿静静地站在林间小路旁。

ex.en: Protecting woodland habitats helps maintain healthy deer populations, but careful management is needed to prevent excessive grazing.
ex.zh: 保护林地栖息地有助于维持健康的鹿种群，但仍需谨慎管理，以防过度啃食植被。

tip: deer单复数同形：one deer，several deer。

ex.en: A hedgehog shuffled through the leaves beside our fence.
ex.zh: 一只刺猬在我们围栏旁的落叶间缓缓爬行。

ex.en: Leaving small gaps beneath garden fences allows hedgehogs to move safely between feeding areas.
ex.zh: 在花园围栏下留出小缝隙，可以让刺猬在觅食区域之间安全通行。

tip: hedgehog是刺猬；porcupine是豪猪，两者不是同一种动物。

senses.en: a night bird with large round eyes and a sharp curved beak

ex.en: A wise grey owl sits quietly on a high tree branch.
ex.zh: 一只聪明的灰色猫头鹰安静地停在高高的树枝上。

ex.en: Because an owl has huge eyes and soft feathers, it can hunt silently in the dark.
ex.zh: 因为猫头鹰有着大眼睛和柔软的羽毛，它能在黑夜里悄无声息地捕食。

col: a big owl｜一只大猫头鹰
a grey owl｜一只灰猫头鹰
an owl at night｜夜里的猫头鹰
tip: owl以元音音素/aʊ/开头，因此表示“一只猫头鹰”时要用an owl。

ex.en: A squirrel buried a nut beside our garden gate.
ex.zh: 一只松鼠在我们花园门旁埋了一颗坚果。

ex.en: Urban parks provide squirrels with food and shelter, although feeding them can alter their natural behaviour.
ex.zh: 城市公园为松鼠提供食物和栖身之所，但投喂可能改变它们的自然行为。

tip: 作动词通常用squirrel away，指悄悄储存。

ex.en: The baby dropped her toy behind the sofa.
ex.zh: 宝宝把她的玩具掉到了沙发后面。

ex.en: Well-designed toys can encourage young children to develop practical skills through creative play and exploration.
ex.zh: 设计精良的玩具可以鼓励幼儿通过创意游戏和探索来培养实践技能。

col: toy with an idea｜随意考虑一个想法
tip: 动词常用toy with；toy with an idea指并不认真地考虑。

senses.en: used to politely ask for or give permission to do something

ex.en: May I come in and sit down now?
ex.zh: 我现在可以进来坐下吗？

ex.en: May I borrow two science magazines from the school reading room today?
ex.zh: 今天我可以向学校阅览室借两本科学杂志吗？

tip: “May I...?”比“Can I...?”语气更委婉礼貌，后面必须接动词原形。

senses.en: to ask someone very strongly and politely for something you need

ex.en: The hungry little puppy sits up to beg for a biscuit.
ex.zh: 那只饥饿的小狗坐起来，祈求得到一块饼干。

ex.en: In the old fable, the cold grasshopper has to beg the hardworking ant for some food.
ex.zh: 在古老的寓言里，受冻的蚱蜢只好向勤劳的蚂蚁祈求一些食物。

tip: 表示“祈求某物”常接介词for，过去式和现在分词都要双写字母g。

ex.en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
ex.zh: 请在上学前喂一下猫。

ex.en: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
ex.zh: 学校供餐计划帮助那些家庭无法持续负担营养食物的儿童吃上饭。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为fed；feed on表示以……为食。

ex.en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
ex.zh: 我们晚饭后去散一会儿步好吗？

ex.en: Under the proposed regulations, employers shall provide appropriate safety equipment for all workers handling hazardous materials.
ex.zh: 根据拟议规定，雇主必须为所有接触危险材料的工人提供适当的安全装备。

tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；Shall we常用于提议。

senses.en: A store where children and families can buy toys and games.

ex.en: There is a big toy shop across from our neighborhood park.
ex.zh: 我们社区公园的对面有一家很大的玩具店。

ex.en: On Children's Day, Lucy went to the toy shop near school to buy a puzzle.
ex.zh: 儿童节那天，露西去学校附近的玩具店买了一副拼图。

col: go to the toy shop｜去玩具店
a small toy shop｜一家小玩具店
inside the toy shop｜在玩具店里
tip: toy修饰shop作定语时用单数，不要写成toys shop。

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢去林中散步的季节。

ex.en: A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.
ex.zh: 更长的旅游旺季可以创造更稳定的就业，但也可能加大当地资源的压力。

tip: season作动词指调味，常用season food with…。

senses.en: a tree with long, thin branches that hang down near water

ex.en: Long green branches of the willow dance softly in the wind.
ex.zh: 柳树长长的绿色枝条在风中轻轻起舞。

ex.en: Beside the calm park lake, a tall willow gives cool shade to people resting on benches.
ex.zh: 在平静的公园湖边，一棵高大的柳树为坐在长椅上休息的人们提供阴凉。

tip: 词尾ow发/əʊ/（美音/oʊ/），和window、yellow的词尾发音相同。

senses.en: A beautiful water plant with large round leaves and pink or white flowers.

ex.en: Look at the pink lotus floating on the quiet pond today.
ex.zh: 看今天安静池塘上漂浮着的那朵粉色莲花。

ex.en: In summer, many visitors go to the park lake to see the blooming lotus flowers.
ex.zh: 夏天，许多游客去公园湖边观赏盛开的莲花。

col: a pink lotus｜一朵粉红莲花
tip: 注意单复数变化，复数形式是在词尾加-es，写作lotuses。

senses.en: A tall tree whose leaves turn bright red or yellow in autumn.

ex.en: There is a tall maple behind our small school garden.
ex.zh: 我们学校的小花园后面有一棵高大的枫树。

ex.en: Every autumn, the leaves on the old maple turn bright red and fall down.
ex.zh: 每年秋天，那棵老枫树上的叶子都会变成亮红色并落下来。

col: a tall maple｜一棵高大的枫树
tip: 词尾-le发/l/音，常见搭配maple leaf表示“枫叶”。

senses.en: A tiny, soft white piece of ice that falls from the sky when it snows.

ex.en: A small white snowflake landed gently on my warm red glove.
ex.zh: 一片小小的白色雪花轻轻落在了我暖和的红手套上。

ex.en: In science class, we learned that every snowflake has six sides and a unique shape.
ex.zh: 在科学课上，我们学到每片雪花都有六条边和独特的形状。

tip: 合成词记忆法：snow（雪）+ flake（薄片）= 雪花。

ex.en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在我的午餐盒里放了新鲜水果。

ex.en: Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 让新鲜水果价格更亲民，可以鼓励低收入家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: the fruits of your labour｜劳动成果
tip: 泛指水果通常不可数；fruits可指种类或成果。

ex.en: We usually eat breakfast together before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 我们通常一起吃完早饭再出门。

ex.en: Schools can encourage children to eat more vegetables by providing affordable meals with a variety of fresh ingredients.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供价格实惠、包含多种新鲜食材的餐食，鼓励孩子多吃蔬菜。

col: eat a balanced diet｜均衡饮食
tip: 不规则变化：eat—ate—eaten。

senses.en: You and I, or other people together with me, used as the subject of a sentence.

ex.en: We walk to school together with our classmates every Monday morning.
ex.zh: 每周一早上，我们和同学们一起走路上学。

ex.en: In music class, we sing cheerful songs and clap our hands together with the teacher.
ex.zh: 在音乐课上，我们唱欢快的歌曲，并和老师一起拍手。

tip: we是主格代词，在句中作主语，配套的be动词要用are。

senses.en: To sit on a two-wheeled vehicle and push the pedals to move forward.

ex.en: I often ride a bicycle with my sister in the park.
ex.zh: 我经常和姐姐在公园里踩单车。

ex.en: On sunny weekends, many children ride a bicycle along the green path near the river.
ex.zh: 在晴朗的周末，许多孩子沿着河边的绿色小路踩单车。

col: ride a bicycle slowly｜慢慢踩单车
learn to ride a bicycle｜学踩单车
ride a bicycle to school｜踩单车去上学
tip: bicycle意为“自行车”，常与ride搭配，注意不要用成drive。

senses.en: To hold a string and let a light toy fly high in the wind.

ex.en: Let us go to the open field and fly a kite.
ex.zh: 我们去开阔的草地上放风筝吧。

ex.en: When the spring wind blows gently, families like to fly a kite in the park.
ex.zh: 春风轻拂时，一家人喜欢去公园里放风筝。

col: fly a kite high｜把风筝放得高高的
go to fly a kite｜去放风筝
fly a kite in spring｜春天放风筝
tip: 动词fly表示“放飞”，单数一只风筝前面要加冠词a。

senses.en: To roll snow into big balls and build a figure that looks like a person.

ex.en: My friends and I make a snowman in the yard today.
ex.zh: 今天我和朋友们在院子里堆雪人。

ex.en: After a heavy snow in winter, children put on warm coats to make a snowman.
ex.zh: 冬天下了一场大雪后，孩子们穿上暖和的外套去堆雪人。

col: make a big snowman｜堆一个大雪人
make a snowman together｜一起堆雪人
go out to make a snowman｜出去堆雪人
tip: 堆雪人固定用动词make，多个雪人时要把snowman变为snowmen。

ex.en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵又让我们吃晚饭迟到了。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 表示交通或车流时不可数，不说a traffic。

ex.en: Our main rule is to leave muddy shoes outside.
ex.zh: 我们最主要的规矩是把沾泥的鞋子留在外面。

ex.en: Clear rules on industrial waste disposal are essential for protecting rivers and ensuring safe drinking water.
ex.zh: 关于工业废物处理的明确规定对于保护河流和保障饮用水安全至关重要。

tip: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

senses.en: A lamp or traffic signal that shines to help people see or stay safe.

ex.en: Please turn off the light before you leave the classroom.
ex.zh: 离开教室前请记得把灯关掉。

ex.en: When we walk across the street, we must stop and wait for the green light.
ex.zh: 过马路时，我们必须停下来等待绿灯亮起。

tip: 字母组合igh发长元音/aɪ/，词尾gh不发音，可指路灯或交通灯。

senses.en: A board or picture with words or symbols that gives people information or rules.

ex.en: Look at that blue sign near the school gate right now.
ex.zh: 现在看一看学校大门附近的那个蓝色标志。

ex.en: A red sign on the road tells drivers to slow down near our primary school.
ex.zh: 路上的一个红色标志告诉司机在我们小学附近要减速。

col: follow the sign｜遵守标志指示
tip: 注意字母g在sign中不发音，读作/saɪn/，不要读出/g/音。

ex.en: Entry to the swimming pool is free today.
ex.zh: 今天进入游泳池免费。

ex.en: Strict entry requirements may prevent capable students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education opportunities.
ex.zh: 严格的入学要求可能使来自弱势背景的优秀学生无法获得高等教育机会。

col: entry requirements｜入学要求；准入条件
tip: 进入某处常用entry to；具体入口通常用entrance。

ex.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
ex.zh: 过马路前要向两边看。

ex.en: Investment in road maintenance can improve public safety and reduce transport costs for local businesses.
ex.zh: 投资道路养护能提高公共安全水平，并降低当地企业的运输成本。

col: the road to recovery｜康复之路
tip: on the road常指在旅途中；road to可比喻通往某结果的途径。

ex.en: We stopped walking when the rain became heavier.
ex.zh: 雨越下越大，我们便停下了脚步。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to stop traffic congestion from becoming worse as populations grow.
ex.zh: 随着人口增长，城市应改善公共交通，防止交通拥堵进一步恶化。

col: stop someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
tip: stop doing是停止做；stop to do是停下去做。

senses.en: To start moving or leave a place to begin a trip or race.

ex.en: Are you ready for the race? Let us go right now!
ex.zh: 你准备好比赛了吗？我们现在就出发吧！

ex.en: When the green light turns on, the runners can go from the starting line together.
ex.zh: 绿灯亮起时，跑步选手们就可以一起从起跑线出发。

tip: go可以表示“出发、开始行动”，常在口令Ready, go!中用到。

ex.en: We waited for the traffic to stop before crossing.
ex.zh: 我们等车辆停下后才过马路。

ex.en: Safer pedestrian routes encourage residents to cross busy roads on foot rather than drive short distances.
ex.zh: 更安全的步行路线鼓励居民步行穿过繁忙道路，而不是短途开车。

tip: cross是动词；across是介词或副词。

senses.en: Next to or along the edge of a street or road.

ex.en: There are many tall green trees growing by the road.
ex.zh: 路边长着许多高大的绿树。

ex.en: In spring, little yellow flowers bloom quietly by the road outside our quiet village.
ex.zh: 春天，我们安静村庄外的路边静静地开着黄色小花。

col: wait by the road｜在路边等待
trees by the road｜路边的树
stand by the road｜站在路边
tip: 介词by在这里表示“在……旁边”，相当于beside。

senses.en: To walk from one side of a street safely to the other side.

ex.en: Always look left and right before you cross the road.
ex.zh: 过马路前一定要先向左看，再向右看。

ex.en: Students should cross the road at the zebra crossing when the traffic light is green.
ex.zh: 交通信号灯变绿时，学生们应该在斑马线处过马路。

col: cross the road safely｜安全过马路
help someone cross the road｜扶人过马路
never run to cross the road｜不要跑着过马路
tip: cross是动词“穿过”，注意不要与介词across混淆使用。

senses.en: To walk or move by a place or person without stopping there.

ex.en: I go past the small bakery on my way home.
ex.zh: 回家的路上我会路过那家小面包店。

ex.en: Every morning, the school bus and many cars go past the city library on time.
ex.zh: 每天早上，校车和许多汽车都会准时路过市图书馆。

col: go past the shop｜路过商店
go past a park｜路过公园
tip: past在这里是介词“经过”，不要写成动词passed。

ex.en: Your clean clothes are drying outside in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 你洗干净的衣服正在外面晒太阳。

ex.en: Buying durable clothes rather than frequently replacing cheap garments can reduce household waste and save resources.
ex.zh: 购买耐穿的衣服，而不是频繁更换廉价服装，可以减少家庭垃圾并节约资源。

tip: 只有复数形式；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

ex.en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
ex.zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要把它改短。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式长裤，另一些则允许员工在工作场所穿得更休闲。

col: a pair of trousers｜一条长裤
tip: 用复数：trousers are；一条用a pair of trousers。

ex.en: I pulled on a warm sweater before going outside.
ex.zh: 出门前，我套上了一件暖和的毛衣。

ex.en: Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
ex.zh: 选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。

tip: 英式英语也常用jumper；sweatshirt指运动衫。

ex.en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
ex.zh: 他在面试前熨好了自己的蓝衬衫。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式衬衫，另一些则允许更休闲的着装。

col: button up a shirt｜扣好衬衫扣子
tip: shirt通常指衬衫；T-shirt才是T恤。

ex.en: Hang your wet coat by the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 把你的湿外套挂在厨房门边。

ex.en: Applying a protective coat to metal structures can reduce maintenance costs and extend their useful life.
ex.zh: 给金属结构涂上保护层可以降低维护成本，延长其使用寿命。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: 动词常用coat A with B，意为给A涂上B。

ex.en: I grabbed my hat before stepping into the sunshine.
ex.zh: 走到阳光下之前，我拿起了帽子。

ex.en: Wearing a wide-brimmed hat can reduce sun exposure, particularly for people who spend long hours working outdoors.
ex.zh: 戴宽檐帽可以减少日晒，对长时间在户外工作的人尤其有用。

tip: 戴着帽子用wear；戴上帽子的动作用put on。

ex.en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
ex.zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。

ex.en: Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.
ex.zh: 政府可以限制年度租金涨幅，以保护家庭免受住房成本骤增的影响。

col: a cap on fees｜费用上限
tip: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。

ex.en: She wrapped a wool scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她在脖子上围了一条羊毛围巾。

ex.en: In colder regions, a locally woven scarf can reflect traditional craftsmanship while providing essential warmth.
ex.zh: 在较寒冷的地区，当地织造的围巾既能体现传统手艺，又能提供必要的保暖。

col: wrap a scarf around your neck｜在脖子上围围巾
tip: 复数可用scarves或scarfs，前者更常见。

ex.en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。

ex.en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
ex.zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。

col: a pair of gloves｜一副手套
tip: 一副手套用 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。

ex.en: One blue sock was hiding under the bed.
ex.zh: 一只蓝袜子藏在床底下。

ex.en: Choosing durable socks made from recycled materials can help consumers reduce clothing waste over time.
ex.zh: 选择用再生材料制作的耐穿袜子，有助于消费者逐渐减少衣物浪费。

col: a pair of socks｜一双袜子
tip: 一双袜子说a pair of socks，sock为可数名词。

senses.en: A common English first name for a boy.

ex.en: Sam is my good friend and he likes playing football.
ex.zh: 萨姆是我的好朋友，他喜欢踢足球。

ex.en: In our science group, Sam draws the weather chart while we write down the notes.
ex.zh: 在我们的科学小组里，萨姆画天气图表，我们负责记笔记。

col: Sam and his friends｜萨姆和他的朋友们
tip: 英语人名首字母必须永远大写，写作Sam，不能写成小写sam。

senses.en: To move a round toy up and down on a string for fun.

ex.en: My little brother loves to play yo-yo after finishing homework.
ex.zh: 我弟弟写完作业后特别喜欢玩溜溜球。

ex.en: During break time on the playground, two boys show us how to play yo-yo well.
ex.zh: 课间在操场上，两个男孩向我们展示怎么把溜溜球玩得好。

col: play yo-yo well｜溜溜球玩得好
learn to play yo-yo｜学玩溜溜球
love to play yo-yo｜喜欢玩溜溜球
tip: yo-yo中间有连字符“-”，注意前后两个yo拼写完全相同。

senses.en: To play a game with a set of paper cards that have pictures or numbers.

ex.en: We often play cards together in the living room on weekends.
ex.zh: 周末我们常一起在客厅里打牌。

ex.en: On rainy afternoons, my grandparents and I sit by the table and play cards happily.
ex.zh: 下雨的午后，我和爷爷奶奶坐在桌旁开心地打牌。

col: play word cards｜玩单词卡游戏
sit and play cards｜坐下来打牌
tip: 扑克牌或游戏纸牌通常不止一张，所以card要加-s用复数cards。

senses.en: To take part in a team game where players kick a ball to score goals.

ex.en: The boys often play football on the green grass after school.
ex.zh: 男孩子们放学后经常在绿草地上踢足球。

ex.en: Every Friday afternoon, our school team meets on the field to play football and practice passing.
ex.zh: 每周五下午，我们校队都会在球场上集合踢足球并练习传球。

tip: play后面直接接球类运动football，中间不能加冠词the或a。

senses.en: To play a sport where two teams hit a ball over a high net with their hands.

ex.en: Our school team loves to play volleyball in the sunny gym.
ex.zh: 我们校队喜欢在阳光明媚的体育馆里打排球。

ex.en: During summer camp by the sea, the students formed two teams to play volleyball on sand.
ex.zh: 在海边夏令营期间，同学们分成两队在沙滩上打排球。

tip: 注意volleyball中间是双写l，与play连用表示运动时同样不加the。

senses.en: To hit a small light ball back and forth over a net on a table.

ex.en: Tim and I play ping-pong in the school gym today.
ex.zh: 今天蒂姆和我在学校体育馆里打乒乓球。

ex.en: After class, many students in China like to play ping-pong to keep healthy and strong.
ex.zh: 下课后，许多中国学生喜欢打乒乓球来保持健康和强壮。

col: play ping-pong well｜乒乓球打得好
learn to play ping-pong｜学打乒乓球
play ping-pong after school｜放学后打乒乓球
tip: 球类运动前不加定冠词the，直接说play ping-pong即可。

senses.en: To play a team game where players bounce and throw a ball through a high hoop.

ex.en: Tom and his classmates play basketball on the school court today.
ex.zh: 汤姆和他的同学们今天在学校球场上打篮球。

ex.en: Our tall PE teacher showed us how to pass and shoot when we play basketball.
ex.zh: 我们高个子的体育老师教了我们打篮球时怎样传球和投篮。

col: play basketball after school｜放学后打篮球
tip: 由basket和ball合成，与play搭配表示打篮球时中间不加the。

senses.en: A flat piece of paper or card put between pages to remember where you stopped reading.

ex.en: I put a pretty bookmark inside my new English book.
ex.zh: 我在我的新英语书里放了一张漂亮的书签。

ex.en: In art class today, every student made a colorful leaf bookmark for our reading week.
ex.zh: 今天的美术课上，每位同学都为读书周做了一张彩色树叶书签。

col: a pretty bookmark｜一张漂亮的书签
tip: 合成词记忆：book（书）+ mark（记号）= 读书时做记号的书签。

ex.en: A small robot cleaned the floor while we ate breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们吃早饭时，一台小机器人清扫了地板。

ex.en: Robots can perform repetitive factory tasks, but workers may need additional training to move into new roles.
ex.zh: 机器人可以执行重复性的工厂任务，但工人可能需要额外培训才能转入新岗位。

tip: robot是可数名词；robotics指机器人学。

senses.en: A book filled with fun stories for children to read.

ex.en: My mother reads a short storybook to me before bedtime.
ex.zh: 睡觉前妈妈会给我读一本简短的故事书。

ex.en: There are many interesting animal tales in this thick storybook in our school library.
ex.zh: 我们学校图书馆里的这本厚故事书中有许多有趣的动物故事。

col: an interesting storybook｜一本有趣的故事书
tip: story和book合写成一个词storybook，复数直接加-s。

senses.en: A children's book that tells a story mainly through colorful pictures.

ex.en: Look at this picture book about cute animals in Africa.
ex.zh: 看看这本关于非洲可爱动物的图画书。

ex.en: Little children love reading a bright picture book because the drawings help explain the story.
ex.zh: 小孩子喜欢看鲜艳的图画书，因为图画能帮助理解故事内容。

col: read a picture book｜读图画书
a colorful picture book｜一本彩色的图画书
tip: 注意picture book中间有空格，不像storybook那样连写。

ex.en: Your idea of growing herbs on the balcony sounds lovely.
ex.zh: 你在阳台上种香草的主意听起来很棒。

ex.en: The idea of free public transport attracts support, but its financial implications require careful consideration.
ex.zh: 免费公共交通这一想法获得了支持，但其财政影响需要慎重考虑。

col: come up with an idea｜想出一个主意
tip: idea是可数名词；“不知道”可说have no idea。

ex.en: We found an interesting little museum near the station.
ex.zh: 我们在车站附近发现了一家有趣的小博物馆。

ex.en: The survey revealed an interesting connection between access to green spaces and residents' overall satisfaction with urban life.
ex.zh: 这项调查揭示了绿地可达性与居民对城市生活的总体满意度之间一种值得关注的联系。

col: an interesting finding｜值得关注的发现
find something interesting｜觉得某事有趣
tip: interesting形容事物引人兴趣，不等于funny好笑。

ex.en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
ex.zh: 跑出去之前，请先系好鞋带。

ex.en: Strong ties between schools and local employers can help young people make a smoother transition into work.
ex.zh: 学校与当地雇主之间的紧密联系，可以帮助年轻人更顺利地进入职场。

tip: tie的现在分词是tying；表示关系时通常用复数ties。

ex.en: We talked about our holiday plans over dinner.
ex.zh: 我们吃晚饭时聊了假期计划。

ex.en: Schools should teach children about the environmental consequences of their everyday choices and habits.
ex.zh: 学校应教导孩子了解日常选择和习惯对环境的影响。

tip: about可表示话题或约数；be about to表示即将。

senses.en: A large number or amount of people or things.

ex.en: We have a lot of fresh apples in the basket.
ex.zh: 我们的篮子里有许多新鲜的苹果。

ex.en: There are a lot of stars shining brightly in the clear autumn sky at night.
ex.zh: 秋夜晴朗的天空中有许多明亮闪烁的星星。

col: a lot of fun｜很多乐趣
tip: a lot of既可修饰可数名词复数，也可修饰不可数名词，意为“许多”。
